name: hermann-infra
description: Measure what the executor host can do for Hermann: docker, the git host, the toolchain (java, maven, claude, git, scanners), disk. Writes p-hermann-infra.

name: hermann-git
description: The git host and the repository as one-off processes: provision Gitea on the Docker host and mint the lanes' token into the vault, create-repo, protect main, open-pr, merge-pr.

name: hermann-bootstrap
description: A new Spring Boot service from Spring Initializr plus the twelve-factor scaffold (env-bound config, structured stdout logs, graceful shutdown, multi-stage Dockerfile, Flyway baseline, admin-task runner, health smoke test, SHA-tagged image build); compiles, commits, pushes, protects main, requests the first audit.

name: hermann-digest
description: One compact, measured picture of the repository per commit (tree, pom, resources, Dockerfile, compose, tests, migrations, commits); queues the twelve factor checks.

name: hermann-audit
description: The twelve factors measured on the repository: factor <NN> scores one factor 0 to 3 with evidence and a fix recipe; scorecard aggregates the twelve per commit.

name: hermann-context
description: Renders the brief a judgement lane reads: goal, principles, decisions, service state, scorecard, risks, upgrades, history; plus the person's answer for a spec brief.

name: hermann-code
description: Implements an approved spec with a spawned Claude Code instance inside the contract (least-privilege tools, repository only), runs the authoritative verify, commits, pushes, opens the pull request, queues verification. revise continues a run with the review points.

name: hermann-verify
description: Proves a pull request in a clean worktree: tests, SHA-tagged image, container against a real Postgres, measured startup, liveness and readiness, timed graceful shutdown, structured stdout.

name: hermann-diff
description: The review brief: bounded diff against main, the spec, the verification result and the coder's summary.

name: hermann-release
description: Closes an iteration: squash-merge the pull request, tag the merge with the spec id, mark run and spec merged, request the audit of main, start the next iteration. Refuses while a blocking risk is open.

name: hermann-brain
description: The brain: observe a merged run into signals and a measured component map, route the curation (one-shot lane or headless agent), apply a curation deterministically (knowledge facts with kind, scope, source and confidence, the plan, proposed decisions, questions), and record a person's answers as facts.
